visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three young individuals, two males and one female, are seated in a bright, modern studio with white walls and a distinctive yellow door frame in the background. The male on the left wears a black denim vest over a white t-shirt, the male in the center has bright pink hair and a light green shirt, and the female on the right wears a white cardigan. They are clapping their hands in a synchronized rhythm while looking directly at the camera. (2) The scene shifts as the individuals take turns responding to on-screen text prompts. The male on the left often makes exaggerated facial expressions, such as wide eyes and mischievous smiles, as he delivers humorous answers. The group frequently bursts into laughter, with the female on the right covering her mouth while giggling. (3) A different male wearing a plaid shirt replaces the pink-haired individual in the center. He holds a small microphone and participates in the rhythmic clapping and answering. The camera remains mostly static, focusing on their upper bodies and facial reactions. (4) A transition occurs where color bars and a 'censor' graphic appear momentarily over the male on the left as he gives a joke answer. The others react with playful shock and more laughter. (5) The final sequence shows the group leaning towards each other, making heart gestures with their hands as they conclude the game. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a studio setting.

A loud pop SFX accompanies the transition to laughter. (3) A new rhythmic cycle begins with the question '過年看到親戚要說什麼'. The beat remains constant. Rapid laughter and group cheering are heard. (4) A high-pitched glitch/beep SFX triggers when a joke answer is censored, followed by a chorus of laughter from all participants. (6) The final phase features a continuous loop of the word '愛' spoken in rhythm, ending with a burst of laughter and a light stinger sound to close the video.
